name: United Nations Development Assistance Framework

framework.name: Consolidate the democratic rule of law, promote good governance, and reform State institutions

children.name: Outcome 1.1 - By 2020, the State institutions, including defense, security, and justice, consolidate the stability and the Rule of Law, democratic participation, and equitable access to opportunities for all
Output 1.1
children.description: Political parties, civil society and other relevant actors, including the population in general, especially the most vulnerable, are sensitized, trained and active in the promotion of social and political dialogue, in civic and political participation and in citizens’ responsibility to better claim and exercise their rights;

children.name: Output 1.1.1 - Parliament, political leaders and relevant stakeholder’s capacity is strengthened to proceed with the inclusive reconciliation and transitional justice process.
Output 1.2
children.description: Parliament, political parties and other organs of sovereignty are strengthened, empowered and resilient to continue the reform process, including the legal framework and modernization of the parliament, national reconciliation and political stabilization through political and social dialogue and democratic governance.

children.name: Output 1.1.2 - Judicial and security institutions are more capable to deliver justice, and to prevent and combat all forms of transnational organized crime, illicit trafficking, corruption and impunity.
Output 1.3
children.description: Government, judicial and security institutions are more transparent, accountable and efficient in providing services, including for preventing and combating all forms of transnational organized crime, illicit trafficking (and underlying and associated crimes), corruption, impunity and other forms of violation of human rights

children.name: Output 1.1.3 - Parliament, key ministries, judicial and military institutions have improved infrastructure, equipment, skills and mechanisms to conduct elections, institutional, legal and policy reform, in line with international human rights standards.
Output 1.4
children.description: Government and justice an security institutions are strengthened, capacitated and able to continue the process of reform and modernization of public institutions in response to citizens’ needs, with a view to preserving human rights, improving equal access to rights, justice and opportunities (especially of the most vulnerable).

children.name: Output 1.1.4 - The population, especially the most vulnerable, has improved access to law and justice to better claim and exercise their rights.

Output 1.1.5 - All relevant stakeholders (public office holders, CSOs, unions, political parties, media, traditional and religious leaders, women and youth groups, private sector) are sensitized and better equipped to promote and enhance inclusive political and social dialogue, contribution to reform, rule of law, good governance, human rights and gender parity.
